text: Being A Brand People Want To Buy From.
Making Your Business Work For You.
Your business doesn't need more noise. It needs the right move.
Pecunia brings strategy, marketing, technology and automation together to help ambitious businesses move beyond where they are now.
We build the system behind growth.
Growth rarely comes from one campaign, one website or one clever advert. It comes from having the right strategy, infrastructure, acquisition channels and systems working together.
We combine marketing, technology, data, creative and automation to build growth systems designed around one objective:
Five connected services. One growth system.
Put your offer in front of the right people.
Read more about organic growth & content
Turn manual processes into growth infrastructure.
Read more about AI, automation & CRM
Help the right people discover your business.
Read more about search visibility & SEO
Distinctive design. Seamless experiences. Explore the websites and digital platforms we've built for real businesses.
Your next customer could start with a search, a map or a question. We connect SEO, local presence and useful answers to help them find a clearer path to your business.
Make your expertise easier to understand.
Clear, accessible information helps people and search systems understand what your business does. We review the foundations behind that visibility.
SEO · Local search · Helpful content · AI-assisted discovery
We don't sell activity. We build for outcomes.

Anyone can launch a campaign. Anyone can build a website. Anyone can generate content. The difference is whether those things actually contribute to growth. Our process starts with the commercial objective and works backwards.
We analyse the business, market, offer, customer journey, competitors and existing performance. We identify what's working. More importantly, we identify what's leaking.

We establish the growth model. Who are we trying to acquire? Which channels should reach them? What should they see? Where should they land? What happens next? What needs to be true for acquisition to be profitable?
Every decision starts with the numbers.
We build the infrastructure required to execute the strategy. Websites. Landing pages. Funnels. CRM systems. Automations. Tracking. Creative. Campaigns. E-commerce systems.
Everything has a role. Everything connects back to the objective.
Strategy means nothing until it meets the market. We launch. We measure. We collect real-world data. Then we use that data to understand what the market actually responds to.

Launching is the beginning, not the finish line. We continuously analyse acquisition, conversion and customer behaviour. Creative gets tested. Offers get refined. Landing pages get improved. Campaigns get restructured. Budgets move towards what performs.
Once we identify what works, we build on it. More qualified traffic. More efficient acquisition. More conversions. More automation. More capacity.
The objective isn't to make something work once. It's to build something that can scale.
Built in 2026. Built for what's next.
Pecunia Studios was founded in 2026 by a marketing specialist and an AI specialist with a shared belief: Modern businesses shouldn't have to choose between great marketing and great technology.
The agency was built to bring both together.
We don't promise magic. We build accountability into the system.
Marketing isn't a vending machine. You can't put money in and guarantee exactly what comes out. Markets change. Customers change. Competition changes. What we can control is the process.
If something isn't working, we don't hide behind the numbers.
We find out why. Then we fix it.
Because you don't need another marketing supplier.
You need a team capable of seeing the entire growth system.
Too many businesses have their website with one company, advertising with another, content somewhere else and automation handled by someone who doesn't understand the customer journey. The result?
Pecunia brings strategy, technology, acquisition, conversion, creative and automation together.
One team. One strategy. One growth system.

We work with ambitious businesses that understand growth requires more than simply turning up the marketing. They have something worth building. Something worth scaling. And the ambition to do it properly.
We're not built around selling isolated services. We're built around solving growth problems.
Let's build the system to capture it.
Tell us where you are, where you want to go and what's currently standing in the way. We'll identify the opportunities, build the strategy and show you what it would take to get there.

Paid media isn't about spending more. It's about understanding who to reach, what to say, where to send them and how to turn attention into action. We build, launch and optimise acquisition campaigns around your audience, offer and commercial objectives.
Reach relevant search demand with campaign structure, keyword research, ad copy and landing-page alignment. Account setup and tracking are reviewed before launch.
Develop Facebook and Instagram campaigns around your offer, audience and creative. Test messages and formats, then refine activity using the available performance data.
Plan platform-appropriate advertising and creative tests where TikTok fits your audience. The channel choice follows the brief rather than an assumption that every business needs every platform.

Plan campaigns, develop creative and review landing pages, tracking and approval requirements.
Monitor delivery and collect initial signals while checking that the customer journey works as intended.
Explain what the data shows, test improvements and recommend the next allocation of effort and spend.
Which advertising platform should we use?

We choose channels around your audience, offer, demand and budget. Google can capture existing search intent, while Meta and TikTok can introduce an offer through suitable creative. You do not need to use every platform.
Is advertising spend included in your fee?
Campaign management and media spend are scoped separately. The proposal explains the service fee, recommended advertising budget and any additional creative or software costs before work begins.
Do you create the adverts and landing pages?
We can scope ad copy, digital creative and landing-page work alongside campaign management. We agree the asset list and approvals first. In-person filming is not part of our service.
How will we know whether the campaigns are working?

We agree useful conversion measures and review the tracking available across the advertising platform, website and CRM. Reporting should connect activity to the commercial objective and explain any gaps or attribution limits.
Can you guarantee leads or a particular return?

No fixed result is guaranteed. Performance depends on the offer, market, competition, budget and conversion journey. We focus on clear measurement, testing and accountable recommendations rather than promised numbers.

text: Turn manual processes into growth infrastructure.

The businesses that scale efficiently aren't necessarily doing more. They're building systems that allow them to achieve more with less friction. We connect your marketing, sales and operations through intelligent technology and automation.
From the first interaction to the final conversion, we identify where time, leads and opportunities are being lost. Then we build the systems to capture them.
Introduce AI where it can support a defined task such as classifying enquiries, summarising information or assisting with knowledge retrieval. Review outputs, limits and human approval requirements.
Create a clear path from the first enquiry to the next action, with ownership, status and follow-up steps that suit your team.
Scope CRM configuration, pipelines and contact records around your sales process. Agree the required fields, access and reporting rather than collecting data without a purpose.
Connect repeated steps such as notifications, task creation and handovers. Define triggers, exceptions and failure handling before switching a workflow on.
Connect compatible systems through APIs or appropriate integration tools. Review permissions, data mapping and technical constraints, including any need for a custom dashboard.
Connect forms and relevant entry points to a usable lead record. Validate information and route enquiries to the right place.
Agree useful qualification criteria and routing rules so the team can prioritise follow-up. Keep important decisions reviewable by a person.
Less manual work. More control. More opportunities captured.
Move routine information between systems without asking people to re-enter it at every stage.
Make responsibility and the next action visible when an enquiry arrives.
Use consistent records and relevant reporting to see where work or opportunities are getting stuck.
Build review points, permissions and exception handling into workflows that need oversight.

Can you connect the tools we already use?

Often, yes, where suitable APIs, integrations and permissions are available. We audit the systems first and explain any restrictions, subscription requirements or custom development needed before promising a connection.
What is the difference between automation and AI?

Automation follows defined triggers and rules. AI can help interpret or generate information where a fixed rule is insufficient. Many useful workflows need only straightforward automation; we choose the approach around the task.
How do you handle access and business data?

We agree which data is needed, where it will be processed and who should have access. Credentials should be handled securely and permissions kept appropriate to the task. Provider terms, retention and sensitive data requirements need review during scoping.
Can AI respond to customers without our approval?

That depends on the agreed use case and risk. We can design draft-only responses, human approval or narrowly defined automated replies. Uncertain cases should be routed to a person rather than allowing an unrestricted system to make commitments.
What happens if a workflow fails or a tool changes?

We agree error notifications, fallback steps and the level of monitoring required. Ongoing support and third-party software costs are scoped separately, since APIs, subscriptions and business processes can change after launch.

text: Help the right people discover your business.

Search visibility starts with a website people can use and search engines can understand. We bring technical SEO, local presence and useful content together to help customers discover and evaluate your business.

We also review how clearly your business and expertise are represented in AI-assisted search. The foundations remain the same: accessible pages, reliable information and answers that serve a real customer need.
Audit crawling, indexability, site structure, redirects, internal linking and page experience. Prioritise fixes that remove barriers to discovering and using your content.
Review Google Business Profile information, location pages and consistency across relevant listings. Help customers understand where you operate and what you offer.
Research customer questions and search intent. Improve titles, headings, copy and page connections so each page has a clear purpose.
Make your business details consistent and implement relevant structured data that matches the visible content. Validate the implementation rather than adding markup without a reason.

Review whether important information is accessible, accurate and clearly organised for AI-assisted discovery. Strengthen the same helpful content and technical foundations used for conventional search.
Create concise answers supported by useful explanations and evidence. AEO and GEO describe overlapping approaches to answer-led and generative search; neither guarantees a recommendation or citation.
Improve product and category structure, useful product details, internal links and relevant product data. Connect search intent to a clear shopping journey.
Review language and regional page structures, localisation and relevant hreflang signals so different audiences can reach the appropriate content.
Review image descriptions, file handling, video pages and relevant metadata so useful visual content can be discovered and understood.
Develop useful content, relevant outreach and consistent business mentions. Focus on genuine relevance and earned coverage rather than bulk link schemes.

Develop or refine service pages and content around real audience questions, with human review for accuracy.
Monitor agreed indicators, explain the results and adjust priorities as the site and market change.
What is the difference between SEO, AEO and GEO?

SEO improves how your website can be discovered and understood in search. AEO focuses on clear answers to questions, while GEO is commonly used to describe visibility within generative search experiences. The work overlaps substantially: useful content, technical accessibility and reliable information support all three.
Can you guarantee first-page rankings or AI recommendations?

No. Search rankings, indexing and AI citations are controlled by the platforms and can change. We focus on improving the foundations, content and measurement, with transparent reporting rather than guaranteed positions or recommendations.
How long does search optimisation take?

It depends on your starting position, the changes required and the level of competition. Some updates can be reflected quickly; others take months to assess. We agree priorities and review points after the audit rather than promising a fixed timetable.
Does this include local SEO and Google Maps?

Local work can include a Google Business Profile review, consistent contact details, relevant location content and practical recommendations. Eligibility, verification and ranking remain subject to the platform’s rules. We confirm the included locations and tasks in the scope.
What does it cost, and can we begin with an audit?

We can scope a focused audit, a defined improvement project or ongoing optimisation. The quote depends on site size, competition, technical work and content needs. Deliverables, reporting and any ongoing costs are agreed before work starts.
